newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CANTONA GIVES UNITED VICTORY WITH LATE STRIKE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CANTONA GIVES UNITED VICTORY WITH LATE STRIKE.

text.p: A late goal by Eric Cantona gave Manchester United a hard-fought 2-1 win over Southampton on Saturday which kept the English champions top of the premier league.

Liverpool striker Stan Collymore also scored late on to clinch a 1-0 victory over Derby, who had Daryl Powell sent off in the 48th minute. The Merseysiders moved into second place, a point behind their arch-rivals.
Third-placed Arsenal drew 0-0 at Leeds on an afternoon of few goals while Wimbledon were held 1-1 at home by bottom side Middlesbrough, for whom Brazilian Emerson missed a penalty.
In the all-London clash Chelsea maintained their remarkable run of success against Tottenham by winning 2-1 at White Hart Lane. Chelsea have lost to Spurs just once in 17 clashes in the 1990s.
Fourth-placed Newcastle entertain Leicester on Sunday.
